reason: Archify primarily turns repositories or system descriptions into validated, interactive technical diagrams with local HTML and image or video exports.

summaries.zh: Archify 可将代码库或系统描述转换为经过验证的交互式架构、工作流、时序、数据流和生命周期图，并导出为多种格式。
summaries.en: Archify turns repositories or system descriptions into validated interactive architecture, workflow, sequence, data-flow, and lifecycle diagrams with multi-format exports.

capabilities: Analyzes repository or system descriptions to create architecture, workflow, sequence, data-flow, and lifecycle diagrams
Generates self-contained interactive HTML diagram artifacts
Exports diagrams as PNG, SVG, WebM, and share-card images
Validates typed JSON diagram inputs and layout or route constraints
Can optionally open revision-verified source files and line ranges when requested
